subject.title: fix(cron): detect ===DONE_ERR=== sentinel in agent final text as failure signal

question: Should OpenClaw make `===DONE_ERR===` in model-generated final text a supported cron failure protocol, or require cron failure alerts to rely only on an explicit typed terminal outcome?
rationale: This is a durable behavior and compatibility decision: relocating text parsing does not determine whether a presentation marker is authoritative enough to alter persisted scheduler state and alert delivery.

options.title: Require typed terminal outcomes
options.body: Reject text-derived failure classification and add or use a producer-owned structured terminal outcome emitted by trusted execution logic.

options.title: Adopt a documented sentinel contract
options.body: Keep the cron-only marker only after documenting its exact grammar, false-positive semantics, compatibility scope, and tests for the real persisted alert path.

recommendation.title: Require typed terminal outcomes
recommendation.body: Reject text-derived failure classification and add or use a producer-owned structured terminal outcome emitted by trusted execution logic.

likelyOwner.reason: The current proposal author is the only evidence-backed routing candidate available in this review record; an owner of embedded-run terminal outcomes should make the product decision.
